summary: PIM Manager 3.1 runs on long-term supported Microsoft software and brings together the improvements of the 3.0 series.

new.title: Runs on supported .NET 10 and PowerShell 7.6
new.text: PIM Manager runs on .NET 10 LTS and PowerShell 7.6 LTS on Microsoft's current image, supported to November 2028. Nothing changes for you.

new.title: Invardia support link
new.text: Health and run results go to Invardia support. Undelivered reports are retried without mailing you, and the status turns amber only after three failed rounds in a row.

new.title: New Get Started steps
new.text: Get Started has steps for Azure resources and Workloads, and a Who needs what table shows each identity's rights.

new.title: Stalled runs are shown and reported
new.text: The Jobs page shows Running far longer than usual, and Invardia support is told. Runs are never stopped.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: Error catalogue pages for every error code, Recognised admin names with *, Drift showing only PIM-named objects, Entra access packages, two-line install, and four-eyes approval and evidence export in both editions.
